northStar: Registered & Reliable — flat, restrained, credibility-first B2B industrial site

navy.role: primary text, headings, dark backgrounds, buttons

gold.role: single accent — eyebrows, checkmarks, badges, hover, CTAs

deliberateDeviationFromBrandSheet.reason: Mustafa's 2026-07-24 redesign intentionally flattened the palette to 4 colors. Do not reintroduce.

arabicKurdish.reason: Somar/Ping run taller and more connected than Gotham; Latin-tuned tight leading causes visual collision

shadowPolicy: none — flat by default, cards use 1px lavender border instead

knownBugPattern.name: navy-on-navy invisible text
knownBugPattern.cause: Direct color rules on classes like .eyebrow override inherited color; navy-background containers without an explicit scoped override render invisible text
knownBugPattern.status: fixed for all known containers as of 2026-07-25; check any new navy-background component against this list

languageHandling.pattern: single markup, lang-scoped spans, no duplication
